title: Chapter 106 — Delivery Operations: Routes, Crews, and The Last Mile
intro: Routing realities, crew craft, and what the floor does to make deliveries succeed.

sections.title: Delivery Is Part of the Sale
sections.content:
The delivery experience is the last impression before the customer decides whether to leave a review or make a referral. A perfect sales process followed by a bad delivery destroys the relationship.

Salespeople influence delivery success by setting accurate expectations, confirming details, communicating special requirements, and following up after delivery. The handoff from sales to delivery should be seamless — not a cliff.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating delivery coordination, ask:

Does the salesperson communicate special delivery requirements — or let the warehouse guess?
Do they follow up after delivery to confirm the experience?
Are delivery problems being flagged and resolved — or ignored?
